news.title: 1 dead in single-vehicle crash on Gwinnett County road
news.summary: A driver is dead following a single-vehicle crash on a Gwinnett County road Monday afternoon.

news.title: Mulberry considers swapping Gwinnett police for its own force
news.summary: A northeast Gwinnett County city that collects no property tax of its own is considering a police department, and the councilman leading the review aims to run it on what residents already pay.

news.title: Woman wanted after shots fired in Gwinnett road rage case
news.summary: Gwinnett County police are searching for 23-year-old Sierra Iman Little after a road rage incident Sept. 7.

news.title: ‘It sounded like Beirut.’ Neighbor describes outburst of gunfire, on car
news.summary: A road in Southwest Atlanta was blocked for hours during the search for a man who police say shot into a car with four people inside.

news.title: How Newnan police plan to stop license plate camera abuse
news.summary: Newnan police officials explained to the city council that the department has restricted its Flock license plate reader system to supervisors to prevent officer misuse.

news.title: Town Center Mall employee catches man touching himself inappropriately in store
news.summary: Cobb County Police say they arrested Steven Biancofiore after someone caught him performing the act in front of shoppers.

news.title: Toddler found wandering in Marietta, police locate his family
news.summary: A boy was found wandering in Marietta around 5:45 p.m., according to authorities.

news.title: Woman wanted for alleged road-rage shooting in Gwinnett County, police say
news.summary: Gwinnett County police seek Sierra Iman Little, 23, accused of aggravated assault and firing shots in a road-rage incident.

news.title: 11Alive helps with arrest of man allegedly stealing HVAC units in DeKalb County
news.summary: According to DeKalb County arrest warrants, Christian Ikechukwu Oji, was caught on video stealing HVAC units from a woman's home on two separate occasions.

news.title: Stacey Humphreys requests execution stay under state law
news.summary: A death row inmate scheduled for execution this week petitioned a Cobb County court to halt his lethal injection and reduce his sentence under a new state law.

news.title: Schools investigate racism claims after Jefferson-Jackson game
news.summary: Atlanta Public Schools and Jefferson City Schools are investigating after allegations of racist behavior surfaced following a high school football game Friday night.

news.title: Racial slurs yelled at marching band leaving high school football game
news.summary: Atlanta Public Schools is investigating allegations that racial slurs were hurled at students after a football game Friday night.

news.title: Man arrested more than two months after triple shooting in northwest Atlanta
news.summary: The shooting injured three siblings and happened in the Joseph E. Boulevard NW location in Atlanta on July 5.
